newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan gasoline retail prices steady as of Jan 10.
newsitem.headline: Japan gasoline retail prices steady as of Jan 10.

text.p: The average retail price of gasoline at petrol stations throughout Japan was 106 yen per litre as of January 10, unchanged from a month earlier, a survey by a research centre showed on Thursday.
The retail prices of gas oil and kerosene were also unchanged at 83 yen per litre and 899 yen per 18 litres respectively, the Oil Information Service Centre said.
Refiners have been raising oil product wholesale prices substantially in recent months, reflecting strong crude prices and a weaker yen against the dollar.
However, retail prices have not been following gains in wholesale prices as a result of cut-throat competition among gasoline stations.
